## FontWeightCoefficients type

How much wider text renders at a given font weight than at a regular one.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type FontWeightCoefficients = Record<string, number>;
```

## Remarks

Keys are matched against the resolved `fontWeight` stringified, so both the numeric weights React Native accepts and the `normal`<!-- -->/`bold` keywords are looked up here. A weight with no entry falls back to a coefficient of 1.
